name: Phoenix Cable Inc

about:
Phoenix Cable, Incorporated (PCI) is a family-owned manufacturer of cable and harness assemblies based in Phoenix, Arizona. Founded in 1994, the company has operated for over 28 years as a privately held business.

PCI produces custom cable and wire harness assemblies for a range of applications, with a specialization in semiconductor assemblies developed over the past 20 years. The shop runs automated tooling for wire preparation, crimping, and cable processing, and stocks common UL-style hook-up wire, jacketed cable from 1 to 60 pair, and a variety of connectors and contacts. Every assembly undergoes 100% inspection and testing to IPC/WHMA-A-620 standards, and the company offers reverse engineering at no cost to produce a workable first article. Additional services include custom cable labeling with Brady™ labels, serialization, and global drop-shipping.

The company serves industries including semiconductor, telecommunications, electronics, industrial, commercial, medical, and instrumentation. Customers range from OEMs requiring second-source or equivalent cable assemblies to organizations needing custom designs built from drawings or reverse-engineered from existing samples.

PCI emphasizes short lead times, a comprehensive quality program backed by ISO 9001:2015 certification, and membership in the Wiring Harness Manufacturers Association. Its assemblers are certified to IPC/WHMA-A-620, and the firm promotes blind drop-shipping worldwide to simplify logistics for clients.
